Abstract
The porous coating increased uptake three-fold [1].

1 Introduction
We ask whether a porous coating changes uptake.

2 Methods
We compared coated and uncoated samples.

3 Results
The porous coating increased uptake three-fold in 24 samples.

References
[1] Doe, J. and Roe, R. (2020). Porous coatings increase uptake. Journal of Surfaces, 4, 10-20. https://doi.org/10.1234/example.1

sources.title: Porous coatings increase uptake
sources.text:
2 Results
In 24 samples, the porous coating increased uptake three-fold compared with uncoated controls.
